# Analysis {.tabset}

## Overview
Violin plots of the log2 fold-change of selected fiber-type marker gene sets for the two differential-expression comparisons.

The edgeR differential-expression results are available via the web application (see README):

1) HDM_F2 vs HDM
2) HDM_F2_STI vs HDM

## Downloading data 

```{r, downloading data, echo = T}


# edgeR deResult objects — see README (Data availability) for access. Place them in ./data/
HDM_F2     <- readRDS(file.path("data", "HDM_F2--over--HDM_deResult.rds"))
HDM_F2_sti <- readRDS(file.path("data", "HDM_F2_STI--over--HDM_deResult.rds"))

```


```{r, defining gene groups, echo=TRUE}


broad_fast_typeII <- c("SIX1", "ACTN3", "ALDOA", "AMPD1", "ATP2A1", "CASQ1", "CKM", "ENO3", "GAPDH", "GPI", "LDHA", "MYH1", "MYH2", "MYL1", "MYLPF", "PFKM", "PGAM2", "PGK1", "PGM1", "PYGM", "TNNC2", "TNNI2", "TNNT3", "TPI1","SLC2A4")
broad_slow_typeI <- c("NFATC1", "ATP2A2", "CASQ2", "COX4I1", "CS", "FABP3", "IDH2", "LDHB", "MYH7", "MYL2", "MYL3", "PDHA1", "PLN", "PPARGC1A", "SDHA", "TNNC1", "TNNI1", "TNNT1")



gene_groups <- list(
  "Broad fast type II"   = broad_fast_typeII,
  "Broad slow type I"    = broad_slow_typeI
)

gene_df <- enframe(gene_groups, name = "gene_group", value = "gene") %>%
  unnest(gene) %>%
  arrange(gene_group, gene)

datatable(
  gene_df,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    autoWidth = TRUE
  )
)
```


```{r extract log2FC and prepare data}

HDM_F2_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(HDM_F2))
HDM_F2_sti_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(HDM_F2_sti))

# Function to extract log2FC for a gene list
extract_log2fc <- function(df, gene_list, gene_group_name) {
  df %>%
    filter(gene_name %in% gene_list) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, log2Ratio, fdr) %>%
    mutate(gene_group = gene_group_name)
}

# Extract log2FC for each gene group from HDM_F2
hdm_f2_broad_fast <- extract_log2fc(HDM_F2_df, broad_fast_typeII, "Broad Fast Type II")
hdm_f2_broad_slow <- extract_log2fc(HDM_F2_df, broad_slow_typeI, "Broad Slow Type I")

# Combine and add comparison label
hdm_f2_combined <- bind_rows(hdm_f2_broad_fast, hdm_f2_broad_slow) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "HDM_F2 vs HDM")

# Extract log2FC for each gene group from HDM_F2_STI
hdm_f2_sti_broad_fast <- extract_log2fc(HDM_F2_sti_df, broad_fast_typeII, "Broad Fast Type II")
hdm_f2_sti_broad_slow <- extract_log2fc(HDM_F2_sti_df, broad_slow_typeI, "Broad Slow Type I")

# Combine and add comparison label
hdm_f2_sti_combined <- bind_rows(hdm_f2_sti_broad_fast, hdm_f2_sti_broad_slow) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "HDM_F2_STI vs HDM")

# Combine all data and add significance column
plot_data <- bind_rows(hdm_f2_combined, hdm_f2_sti_combined) %>%
  mutate(significant = ifelse(log2Ratio > 0.5 & fdr < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Significant"))

# Check which genes were found, and report any missing from each result (so silent drops are visible)
report_missing <- function(df, gene_list, label, comparison) {
  missing <- setdiff(gene_list, df$gene_name)
  cat(comparison, "-", label, ":", length(gene_list) - length(missing), "/", length(gene_list), "found\n")
  if (length(missing)) cat("   missing:", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
report_missing(HDM_F2_df,     broad_fast_typeII, "Broad Fast Type II", "HDM_F2 vs HDM")
report_missing(HDM_F2_df,     broad_slow_typeI,  "Broad Slow Type I",  "HDM_F2 vs HDM")
report_missing(HDM_F2_sti_df, broad_fast_typeII, "Broad Fast Type II", "HDM_F2_STI vs HDM")
report_missing(HDM_F2_sti_df, broad_slow_typeI,  "Broad Slow Type I",  "HDM_F2_STI vs HDM")

```

## Violin Plots


```{r violin plot faceted with significance, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}

# Alternative: Faceted violin plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = comparison, y = log2Ratio, fill = comparison)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(gene_group, comparison)),width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = significant), width = 0.1, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  facet_wrap(~gene_group, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "",
    y = "Log2 Fold Change",
    fill = "Comparison",
    color = "Significance: (log2FC > 0.5 & FDR < 0.05)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HDM_F2 vs HDM" = "#ffb000", "HDM_F2_STI vs HDM" = "#648fff")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "red", "Not Significant" = "#B0B0B0"))



```

```{r}
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = comparison, y = log2Ratio, fill = comparison)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(gene_group, comparison)), width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = significant), width = 0.1, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = gene_name, color = significant),
    size = 2.5,
    max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  facet_wrap(~gene_group, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "",

    fill = "Comparison",
    color = "Significance: (log2FC > 0.5 & FDR < 0.05)"
  ) +

    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),

  ) +
```
